after_expected_public_metadata.description:
UNCERTIFIED — no hash-bound Viridis Comparator certificate covers this deposit's claims. Lean sources may compile but have not been independently certified. Results are conditional on the stated model assumptions.

Historical description:

Standalone record of the Viridis Canon (Cognition / Intelligence-Bound self-application) — the core IB canon spine is unchanged (frozen at v9). Proves the Cognitive Throughput Theorem (CTT): an embodied cognitive system modeled as an open quantum (GKSL/Lindblad) process on a Fisher–Rao manifold, performing simultaneous Pierra–Censor–Elfving Bregman multiprojection onto sensory, model, and motor constraint sets, has a maximum certified information-acquisition rate that obeys an inverse square-root envelope dI_cog/dt|max(N) = K_cog · N^(−1/2), with throughput constant K_cog = √(2·W_attn·Φ_eco/(k_B T ln 2)). The decoupled/coupled dichotomy — Φ_eco = 0 ⇒ K_cog = 0 versus Φ_eco > 0 ⇒ K_cog > 0 — is the cognitive face of the Intelligence Bound: cognitive throughput is gated by physical/ecological coupling, giving a thermodynamic foundation for the necessity of AI–ecology co-evolution. The 13th Intelligence-Bound self-application (the Knower).

Scope. Lean 4 (Aristotle-verified, zero sorry, axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}) certifies the structural results — the inverse-√ scaling law, the conserved throughput invariant, strict antitonicity (the attentional iris), and the decoupled/coupled coupling dichotomy — not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
after_expected_public_metadata.notes: Viridis Canon, standalone record (Cognition / Intelligence-Bound self-application). Lean 4 proofs (Aristotle project b04c2897-6470-4a34-b9a7-1a15e6b373a7, zero sorry, axioms within {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}) certify: (T1) the throughput envelope R(K,N)=K/sqrt(N) satisfies the inverse-square-root homogeneity R(K, c*N)=R(K,N)/sqrt(c); (T2) the conserved attention-budget invariant R(K,N)*sqrt(N)=K; (T3) strict antitonicity of the envelope in observation count (the attentional iris); (T4) a decoupled agent (Phi_eco=0) has zero throughput constant; (T5) any ecological coupling (Phi_eco>0, positive attention power and temperature) yields a strictly positive throughput constant K_cog=sqrt(2*W_attn*Phi_eco/(k_B*T*ln2)). The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes; the paper develops a richer constant (with an explicit decoherence rate) than the verified abstraction. Working paper; not peer-reviewed. Does NOT modify the core canon spine (frozen at v9, record 20724138).
